purpose: Phase-1.5 real-graph ML re-baseline: replaces the stub-era ml_baseline_v1.json (which ran on the length-stubbed Goseong skeleton). Generated on the REAL Goseong OSM graph (197,819 nodes) at staged scale. NOT acceptance evidence; Phase-7 physics-feature ablation anchor.
predecessor: results/ml_baseline_v1.json (stub-era, 15,870 rows, macro_f1 0.887, 3-class, KMeans/SHAP/NL unimplemented) — retained as the Phase-0 historical reference.
claim_scope: Phase 10 post-simulation ML decision-support analysis only; labels are derived from simulation outputs and do not prove real-world calibration, publication readiness, final-study readiness, formal acceptance, or operational forecasting.

input.graph_source: data/cache/goseong_corridor_road.graphml (live_overpass_osm_snapshot, 197,819 nodes / 298,012 edges) — real OSM, NOT the stub
input.design: staged_pilot profile, 7 policies x 8 scenarios x 5 seeds (the 9th scenario goseong_spatial_tancheon_corridor excluded: its spatial-hazard bbox selects no candidate edges on the single-corridor reduced analysis graph — a documented graph-reduction/spatial-scenario coupling gap, not an ML defect).
input.success_deadline_min: None (defaults to time_limit=480, the 8h operational window; both alternatives complete in the no-disruption baseline at makespan ~288-291 min).

model.class_count_note: Bimodal at the 8h deadline: 210 rows completion>=0.95 (normal), 70 rows completion<0.05 (failure). No intermediate (주의/위험) classes populate at this scale — the label rule's populated-class count depends on the input completion distribution (CLAUDE.md). Intermediate classes would emerge from milder disruptions or a tighter success_deadline ladder (Phase 5).
model.leakage_boundary: Features limited to policy/scenario/mode fields and selected edge count; completion_rate and censored_count used only for label derivation, not as model features.

perfect_score_caveat: macro_f1=1.0 is a SCALE/FEATURE ARTIFACT, not a robust model. At staged scale the failure class is perfectly determined by a single feature (scenario_type=blocked: gain 33.9, all other features gain 0; SHAP mean_abs 3.86, rest 0). The bimodal completion distribution makes the classes linearly separable. Discriminative power must be re-evaluated on the full 15,870-row design (Phase 6) with richer class diversity and the Phase-7 physics-feature set (threat_index / mode-mix / fallback / critical-link survival / corridor-id / BPR v,c / transfer / fleet).

implemented_components.shap_status: shap_computed (shap>=0.45 installed in env; TreeExplainer, no fallback)
implemented_components.note: All four D-ML components now implemented and exercised on real-graph output. Contrast ml_baseline_v1.json where kmeans/shap/nl were false (Phase-0).

phase7_ablation_anchor: Re-baseline this real-graph staged macro_f1=1.0 (2-class, bimodal, 22 features) against the Phase-7 physics-feature model on the full 15,870-row real-graph design. The current perfect score is uninformative about real discriminative structure; the ablation's value is comparative, not absolute.
